description: This header file defines inline functions for converting MIME types to GStreamer capabilities (GstCaps) and vice versa, within the 'firebolt::rialto::server' namespace. It includes mappings for various media MIME types and functions to create GstCaps objects and extract supported MIME types from GstCaps vectors.

methods.name: createSimpleCapsFromMimeType
methods.description: Creates a GstCaps object representing simple caps for a given MIME type, based on a media source and a GstWrapper instance.

methods.name: convertFromCapsVectorToMimeSet
methods.description: Converts a vector of GstCaps pointers to a set of supported MIME type strings by checking for intersections with predefined caps.
